description_en: This south-facing three-tiered Jora Gaṇeśa (lit. a pair of Gaṇeśas) Temple is located in an open square at the Valkhu Ṭola. A carved tympanum (toraṇa) is kept atop the main door to the sanctum. Two pinnacles sit atop the Temple, one on the apex point and the other on the second tier.A pair of stone Gaṇeśa statues sitting on thesukhāsanaposture are enshrined in the sanctum. Both statues are damaged; the upper body of the statue on the left-hand side is broken, and the statue on the right-hand side is in a state of deterioration, making it difficult to identify the weapons carried by the deity. A brasstoraṇaon which an image of Gaṇeśa flanked by his consorts is carved, can be seen above the pair of Gaṇeśa statues. In front of the sanctum, a statue of a mouse (the vehicle of Gaṇeśa) is placed. Images based on the major episodes of theRāmāyaṇahave been carved on the wooden capitals of the first floor.The Jośī families from Bakhuṃ Bāhāḥ and Jośī Nani worship Jora Gaṇeśa as their lineage deity. Aguṭhīmanaged by the Jośī families, therefore, takes care of the Temple. One of the inscriptions at the site (see below) informs us that (Jośī) Keśavarāja Bhāro constructed the Temple in 1682 CE.
description_ne: वल्खु टोलको चोकैमा अवस्थित दक्षिणाभिमुख यस गणेश मन्दिरको गर्भगृहभित्र एकजोडा (दुईवटा) गणेश मूर्ति भएकाले यसलाई जोर गणेश मन्दिर भनिन्छ । तीनतले यस मन्दिरका छानाहरू तामाको पाताले मोडिएका छन् । दोस्रो तलाको मोहोडा भागमा पित्तलको गजुर छ भने माथिल्लो तलामा पनि पित्तलकै छत्र सहितको गजुर चढाइएको छ । मन्दिरको प्रवेशद्वारको दायाँ–बायाँ एक जोडा सिंहमूर्ति स्थापित छन् र पित्तलका ध्वजाहरू पनि खडा गरिएका छन् । ढाकाको माथि पित्तलको तोरण छ जसको केन्द्रमा १० हात र ६ शिर भएका गणेशको मूर्ति छ । मन्दिरको भुइँतलाको थामो माथि (मेथ माथि) राखिएको काठमा रामायणका प्रमुख घटनाका दृष्यहरू कुँदिएका छन् त्यसको तल्लो भागमा संक्षेपमा घटना बुझाउने अभिलेखहरू कुँदिएका छन् । मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा खोपीभित्र गणेशका दुई ढुङ्गाका मूर्ति राखिएका छन् । दुईमध्ये पूर्वतिरको गणेशको माथिल्लो भाग खण्डित भई खुट्टाको भाग मात्र देख्न सकिन्छ भने पश्चिमतिरको चार हात भएको गणेश मूर्ति पनि खिइसकेकाले आयुधहरू स्पष्ट रूपमा चिन्न सकिने अवस्था छैन । यी दुबै मूर्तिलाई केन्द्रमा पारी पित्तलको तोरण चढाइएको छ जसको केन्द्रमा सुखासनमा बसेका गणेशको मूर्ति रहेको छ । गर्भगृहको ठिक अगाडि गर्भगृहतिर फर्किएको मुसाको प्रतिमा स्थापित छ ।घर तथा खेतमा मुसाले दुःख दिए जोरगणेशको पूजा गरेमा मुसाको समस्याबाट छुटकारा मिल्छ भन्ने विश्वास लिएर पूजा गर्न आउनेहरूको संख्या पहिला धेरै रहेको तर आजभोलि पूज्न आउनेको संख्यामा केही कमी आएको स्थानीयहरू बताउछन् । यी जोर गणेशका मूर्तिहरूलाई बखुं बाहाः र जोशी ननिका जोशी खलकहरूले कुलदेवताका रूपमा पूज्ने गर्दछन् । यिनै जोशी खलकहरू संबद्ध गणेशको गुठी पनि अस्तित्वमा छ । मन्दिरमा तेस्रो तला थप्ने कार्य नेपाल संवत् ८०५ मा दैवज्ञ (जोशी) केशवराज भारोबाट भएको हो भने मन्दिरको मर्मत एवं विभिन्न साजसज्जाका कार्यहरू पनि जोशीहरूबाटै भइआएको कुरा मन्दिरमा प्राप्त अभिलेखहरूबाट थाहा पाइन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: At the center of the sanctum is a niche where the main images of Gaṇeśa are kept. The brasstoraṇaabove the niche was added by Suraja Māna Jośī and Ratnalāla Jośī.

historical_events.event_name: Construction (probably the initial construction of the temple)
historical_events.event_description: There is an inscription on the base of a strutat the south-west corner of the first floor. It mentions that a group of nine member led by Keśavarāja Bhāro constructed something in NS 802. The construction work it refers to was most likely the initial construction of the temple.
The temple used to have two storeys. The third storey was added by Keśavarāja Bhāro and Siddhirāja Bhāro.
A woodentoraṇawas installed above the eastern bay of the ground floor by Durgārāja Daivajña.

historical_events.event_name: Addition of embossed eaves boards to the edges of the roofs
historical_events.event_description: Embossed eaves boards were added to the edges of the roofs by Maĩñā Jośī and her family.
A bell was added in front of the temple by Akavara Siṃ, the son of Dhuna Siṃ from Ṅyāta Ṭola.

historical_events.event_name: Renovation of the two lower roofs by replacing the tiles with copper plates
historical_events.event_description: There used to be a tiled roof (jhĩgaṭī) on the two lower storeys. However, the tiles were removed from roofs and replaced with copper plates by ValkhuGaṇeśa Upabhokttā Samiti. The President of the Samiti was Mohana Prasāda Jośī. The old tiled roofs can be seen inPruscha's (1975, 177) inventory.

historical_events.event_name: Covering of the crafted wooden frame with embossed brass plate
historical_events.event_description: There is a niche at the centre of the sanctum where the main images of Gaṇeśa are kept. The outer part of the niche is decorated in a crafted wooden frame. This frame was covered with embossed brass plate by Kīrtimāna and his wife Padmāvatī.
Brass flags were erected in front of the temple by Lakṣmīsudha and his wife Tutakī.
